name: 78414 · Corp Christi, TX
findings: ZIP 78414 (Corp Christi) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78414 (Corp Christi) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78414 (Corp Christi) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
